resources.string: Optional local evidence tools. Each starts off and needs a fresh purpose-specific acknowledgement.

Recognizes only the first complete TLS ClientHello SNI or cleartext HTTP headers already seen by the local forwarder. No TLS decryption, body, header value, TCP reassembly, remote receiver, or per-flow PCAP is implemented.
This is a fresh acknowledgement for this start attempt. Values stay in bounded memory and are cleared when monitoring stops.
Protocol evidence acknowledged for the next session
Reads a safe ASCII server name from an unencrypted ClientHello; it does not decrypt TLS.
Records method/status and HTTP version only. Request/response bodies and sensitive header names/values are not retained.
Unavailable until local monitoring is active and this session\'s acknowledgement is accepted.
No bounded SNI or cleartext HTTP observation is available yet.
first bytes were fragmented or incomplete; no reassembly
message exceeded the small parser bound
Technical limits: bounded observations only; no payload bytes, body, header values, TLS decryption, TCP reassembly, remote upload, or per-flow PCAP.
Choose a local SAF document. The NDJSON contains bounded technical metadata only; endpoint addresses, DNS values, app names, flow IDs, and payload are omitted.
Ready to export: %1$d flows, %2$d dropped when full. Payload contents are never kept.
Export is unavailable until a bounded flow snapshot exists.
The local document could not be written.

Keeps the page path and site name for unencrypted web requests, so the full address can be shown and exported. A web address can itself contain a login token or an account number, so this stays off unless you turn it on.
Turn on \"Also record the web address\" above to export web requests.
HAR file saved. It lists the requests seen, without headers or content.
The HAR file could not be saved.
Web addresses, protocol details and readable content, each behind its own consent.
Write this session to a file you choose, for use in other tools.
HTTPS inspection, rooted capture and live streaming. Each needs extra setup and consent.
Save as CSV (opens in any spreadsheet)
